quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

50 Questions • Passing Score 40

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the lane you want to enter is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass if the lane ahead is clear.

questions.question: Your blind spot is the area of the road you:

options.text: Cannot see without turning your head.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cannot see without turning your head.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas you cannot see without turning your head. They are located to the sides and behind your vehicle.

questions.question: Warning signs are most commonly what color?
questions.explanation: Most warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black writing. They warn drivers about unexpected road conditions.

questions.question: What should you do if your accelerator gets stuck while driving?

options.text: Reach down and try to pull it up.
Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal firmly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Shift to neutral and press the brake pedal firmly.
questions.explanation: If your accelerator sticks while driving, keep your eyes on the road. Shift into neutral and press the brake pedal firmly. Pull safely off the road and turn off the engine.

questions.question: On a long trip, what helps prevent driver fatigue?

options.text: Stop and rest every two hours.
Drive with one eye open at a time.
Alternate feet on the gas pedal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest every two hours.
questions.explanation: To avoid fatigue on long trips, stop every two hours for a break. If you feel sleepy, pull over safely and rest or stay somewhere overnight.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, you should:

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show the driver they are wrong.
Do something aggressive back at them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, stay calm and get out of their way. Trying to retaliate makes the situation worse and more dangerous.

questions.question: After a school bus stops to let children off, you should:

options.text: Not move until the children wave at you.
Watch for children walking along the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking along the road.
questions.explanation: After stopping for a school bus with its stop arm out and lights flashing, watch for children walking on the road. Always drive carefully near children.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order for a traffic light?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is on top and green is on bottom. On a horizontal light, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: You have a green light but pedestrians are crossing against their red light. You should:

options.text: Speed up and pass in front of them.
Stop and let them cross safely.
Drive close to them to scare them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and let them cross safely.
questions.explanation: Always let pedestrians cross safely, even if you have a green light. Be careful around pedestrians in all situations.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When can you go through an intersection with a stop sign but no stop line or crosswalk?

options.text: After slowing down to check for other traffic
After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
After stopping at least 20 feet before the intersection

questions.correctAnswerText: After coming to a complete stop and checking that it is safe
questions.explanation: Stop before entering the intersection at any stop sign. If there is no stop line or crosswalk, stop before the intersection and go when it is safe.

questions.question: A driver entering public traffic from a driveway or private road should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
Assume other drivers will change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the public road.
questions.explanation: When entering from a driveway or private road, yield to all traffic on the public road. Merge safely when you have space.

questions.question: While backing up, you should:

options.text: Open your door to see behind the vehicle.
Turn your head and look through the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look through the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing up. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to look through the rear window. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: Stop lines are solid white lines painted across traffic lanes at:
questions.explanation: Stop lines are solid white lines at intersections and pedestrian crosswalks. They show exactly where drivers must stop.

questions.question: You must drive with extra caution near a pedestrian with a white cane because:
questions.explanation: A white cane means the pedestrian is blind. Slow down, yield the right-of-way, and be ready to stop to avoid hitting them.

questions.question: You can legally pass on the right side of another vehicle when:

options.text: The vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is an available passing lane

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is waiting to turn left and there is an available passing lane
questions.explanation: You may pass on the right if there is an available passing lane and the vehicle is turning left or about to turn left. You may also pass on the right on multilane roads with two or more lanes going the same direction. Never drive off the pavement to pass.

questions.question: If you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When leaving your vehicle, turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will become one lane ahead.

questions.question: You have the right-of-way when turning left on which traffic signal?
questions.explanation: A green arrow means you can go in the direction the arrow points. Oncoming traffic must stop.

questions.question: When there is an oncoming car on your left and a bicyclist on your right, you should:

options.text: Let the car pass, then pass the bicycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass, then pass the bicycle.
questions.explanation: Handle one hazard at a time. Let the oncoming car pass first, then pass the bicyclist. Never try to squeeze between both at the same time.

questions.question: What driving technique helps prevent crashes on icy or snowy roads?

options.text: Add extra weight to your vehicle for better grip.
Leave highways as soon as possible.
Drive slower and stay farther behind other cars.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slower and stay farther behind other cars.
questions.explanation: Slow down on snowy or icy roads. Driving slower and increasing your distance from other vehicles are the best ways to avoid crashes in these conditions.

questions.question: A driver entering an interstate from an entrance ramp should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
Assume other drivers will move to make room.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering an interstate from a ramp, you must yield to traffic already on the highway. Merge safely when there is an opening.

questions.question: To enter a freeway safely, you should:

options.text: Signal, let other traffic pass first, and enter at the same speed as the traffic.
Signal and enter. Other traffic must yield to you.
Drive slowly so you can check traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Signal, let other traffic pass first, and enter at the same speed as the traffic.
questions.explanation: Signal and enter the freeway at the same speed as other traffic. Always let other drivers go first when merging.

questions.question: What is true about drowsy drivers?

options.text: They should drink strong black coffee to stay awake.
They can drive badly enough to seem drunk.
They can stay alert by opening a window and turning up the radio.

questions.correctAnswerText: They can drive badly enough to seem drunk.
questions.explanation: Drowsy drivers can drive poorly in ways that look like drunk driving. Opening a window, playing radio, or drinking coffee is not enough to make a drowsy driver safe.

questions.question: How do you check your blind spots?

options.text: Turn your head and look over your shoulders.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look over your shoulders.
questions.explanation: Blind spots are areas around your vehicle you cannot see in your mirrors. Check them by turning your head and looking over your shoulder.

questions.question: What is the best way to handle a tailgater?

options.text: Speed up to create more distance.
Brake suddenly to make them back off.
Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change lanes or slow down gradually to let them pass.
questions.explanation: Watch traffic behind you often to see if someone is following too close. If they are, slow down and let them pass. Most rear-end crashes happen because drivers follow too closely.

questions.question: When stopped by police for a traffic violation or equipment check, you must show:
questions.explanation: You must have your driver's license, vehicle registration, and proof of insurance with you when driving. You must show all three when stopped by police.

questions.question: You see a driver ahead using one hand and talking to a passenger. You should:

options.text: Recognize that they are not paying full attention and are less safe.

questions.explanation: Do not get distracted while driving by passengers, searching for items, reading, or daydreaming. If another driver seems distracted, stay farther away because the risk of a crash increases.

questions.question: What is the default speed limit in condominium complexes?
questions.explanation: The speed limit in condominium complexes is 25 mph unless a different speed limit is posted. Follow posted speed limits when they differ from the default.

questions.question: When turning left, you must yield to:

options.text: Other drivers already in the intersection.

questions.explanation: When turning left, yield to oncoming traffic. Also always yield to pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers who are already in the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: At an intersection where a stop is required but there are no stop line or crosswalk markings, what should a driver do?

options.text: Is required to slow down to make sure crossing traffic is clear.
Should stop only at a place where they can see at least 200 feet on either side, even if they have to enter the intersecting roadway.
Should stop where they have a clear view of approaching traffic before they enter the intersecting roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should stop where they have a clear view of approaching traffic before they enter the intersecting roadway.
questions.explanation: Stop at the closest point to the intersecting roadway where you can see approaching traffic clearly. Do not enter the intersecting roadway to get a better view.

questions.question: You cannot pass from either side of a ____ centerline.
questions.explanation: A double solid yellow line means traffic from both directions cannot cross the center line to pass other vehicles.

questions.question: When it starts to sleet or snow, you should:

options.text: Keep your windshield and mirrors clear.
Allow additional distance between your vehicle and the vehicles that you are following.

questions.explanation: In snowy weather, keep your windshield and mirrors clear. Increase your distance from other vehicles because icy roads make it harder to stop.

questions.question: If a vehicle coming toward you is using high beams, you should look toward the ____ of the road.
questions.explanation: Look toward the right side of the road to avoid being blinded by the headlights. This lets you see enough to stay on your course until the vehicle passes.

questions.question: A driver who travels much slower than the speed limit:

options.text: Should not let following cars pass.
May create a dangerous driving environment.

questions.correctAnswerText: May create a dangerous driving environment.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic can be hazardous. On a two-lane road, pull over and let cars pass if traffic backs up behind you. Only drive well below the speed limit when conditions require it.

questions.question: Which is NOT a factor in how far it takes to stop your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. This changes based on speed and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: When changing lanes, what is important to do?

options.text: Signal your intentions ahead of the lane change.
Make sure the lane is clear before entering.

questions.explanation: Signal before changing lanes or exiting. Turn your head to check your blind spot. Make sure the lane is clear before you move.

questions.question: When making a right turn, your car must be:

options.text: Near the center of the street.
Close to the left side of the street.
Close to the right side of the street.
Past the center of the intersection when you begin to turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Close to the right side of the street.
questions.explanation: Get as far to the right side of the road as possible before turning right. Do not cut across traffic lanes.

questions.question: If you become stranded in a snowstorm, what should you do?

options.text: Get out of the car and walk for help.
Lie down in your car and sleep.
Walk into the road to get other drivers' attention.
Stay in your car. You are most likely to be found if you stay in your vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay in your car. You are most likely to be found if you stay in your vehicle.
questions.explanation: If stranded in a snowstorm, stay in your car and wait for help. You are more likely to be found if you stay in your vehicle. It is also unsafe to walk in a snowstorm.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the divided highway is about to end.

questions.question: What does a red traffic light mean?
questions.explanation: A red traffic light means you must stop before entering the intersection. You must stop at any stop line and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: If a police officer is directing traffic at a working traffic light, what should drivers do?

options.text: Watch what the cars next to you are doing.

questions.explanation: Traffic signals help keep traffic moving and prevent crashes. Drivers must obey traffic signals. However, when a police officer is directing traffic, drivers must follow the officer's directions instead.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing the radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make many decisions while driving. You need to focus all your attention on driving. Any extra activity can create a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: What does a flashing red traffic light mean?

options.text: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
You do not have to stop completely.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a stop sign.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same thing as a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, yield to other traffic and pedestrians, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: Does drinking coffee after drinking alcohol help you sober up?

options.text: Yes, it decreases blood alcohol concentration.
Yes, it cancels the effect of alcohol.
No, it has no effect on blood alcohol concentration.
No, it increases blood alcohol concentration.

questions.correctAnswerText: No, it has no effect on blood alcohol concentration.
questions.explanation: Coffee does not reduce blood alcohol concentration. While it may help you stay awake, it cannot change your blood alcohol level or make you sober.

questions.question: When you see a steady green traffic light, what should you do?

options.text: Continue driving, unless vehicles or pedestrians are already in the intersection.
Stop if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a four-way stop.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving, unless vehicles or pedestrians are already in the intersection.
questions.explanation: At a steady green light, yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk and vehicles still in the intersection. You can continue driving, but drive at a speed that lets you slow down or stop if the light changes.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop your car?
questions.explanation: Road condition greatly affects your ability to stop. You must slow down when road conditions are poor to stay in control. Driving too fast on slippery roads makes it unsafe to stop.

questions.question: What is the speed limit on state highways when no other sign is posted?
questions.explanation: The default speed limit on state highways is 55 mph. Follow posted speed limit signs if they show a different speed.
